title: Contrix Source Export Policy Attestation
description: Optional attestation embedded in cx.content.import_attestation. Issued by source-Realm policy authority; binds importer to (source_realm_id, content_hash, destination, frontier). Mirror reducer only verifies signature integrity; real export enforcement is in source-side agent runtime. See spec/v1/zh/extensions/agent-workspace-profile.md §10.3 and §16.

authority_did.description: Source-Realm policy authority (typically Realm admin actor or designated policy server).

policy_hash.description: JCS-canonical hash of the source Realm's import_to_external_space policy state at issuance time.

import_destination_realm_id.description: Destination mirror Realm ID; signature binding prevents attestation replay to other Realms.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 over JCS-canonicalized cx.content.import_attestation.content object. Algorithm: 1) Extract content; 2) JCS canonicalize per spec/v1/zh/conformance/encoding.md; 3) SHA-256; 4) Prefix 'sha256:'. Reader recomputes and compares.

signature.description: authority_did signature over canonical signing input: JCS({schema_id: 'cx.schema.content.source_export_policy_attestation.v1', domain: 'cx.domain.export_policy_attestation.v1', body: <all required fields EXCEPT 'signature'>}). Domain separator prevents signature replay across attestation types.
